title: Patch: an Embiggened version costs its normal price plus a premium
notes: An embiggen card's Embiggened version costs its normal version's finished price (every rung of R65 and R455, floored at 0) plus its Embiggen premium, B - A; a Garden's premium replaces it and noEmbiggenPremium makes it 0 (R5109000). Every embiggen card's Embiggened line is relabeled with its premium, 'Embiggened (+N):', in English and Chinese, and patch diffs write '(2) Cost, Embiggened (+2)'; the second cost badge stays the realized price and shows under a discount too (R5109001).

player.title: Embiggen is a flat extra cost
changes: Embiggen now costs a flat +N on top of the card's current price, so discounts and set prices apply to both versions alike.
A card that costs (0) after a discount still pays its whole Embiggen extra, and "costs (1)" effects make its Embiggened version cost (1) plus the extra.
Professor Curvature lowers an Embiggen card's two prices together, only when its normal price is (4) or more.
Under Mountaintop Garden, its extra replaces the card's own, on top of the card's current price.
text: Every Embiggen card's Embiggened line names its extra cost: "Embiggened (+2):" in place of "Embiggened (4):".
The small second price beside the cost gem still shows what the Embiggened version costs right now, discounts included.
